review.posthog_relevance: Adds URL parameter parsing and shared date range defaults for the Anomalies tab, while explicitly excluding other tabs from these parameters. This establishes the state wiring and URL compatibility layer for the Anomalies feature.

It only shows the URL parameter parsing and tab-specific state wiring. Without the actual anomaly detection request and the shared guard implementation, the tier cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds a shared default date range and its own URL parameter, and wires the Anomalies tab to read/write these params while ignoring them on other tabs.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Anomalies tab to carry its own service and date range in the URL, while the Viewer tab does not. This prevents the Viewer tab from being affected by Anomalies-specific URL params, and vice versa.
